title: Neural Aggregate Formation Protocol
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x84fryw

steps.title: Harvest iPSCs
steps.instruction: Harvest iPSCs once they reach 75-85% confluency.

substeps.instruction: Gently tap the plate to dislodge cells

steps.title: Collect and Concentrate Cells
steps.instruction: Collect the cell suspension and concentrate via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Dilute Accutase with 4 mL of DMEM/F12 medium
Collect cell suspension in a 15 mL conical tube
Centrifuge cells at 750 rpm for 3 minutes
Carefully aspirate medium from the iPSC pellet

steps.title: Prepare iPSC Suspension
steps.instruction: Resuspend and adjust the iPSC concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 3 mL of neural induction medium to the iPSC pellet
Adjust the volume of iPSC suspension to 450,000-650,000 cells/mL using neural induction medium supplemented with Rock inhibitor (10 μM final)

steps.title: Seed Cells in V-Bottom Plate
steps.instruction: Seed the cells into a 96-well plate to form spheres.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of iPSC suspension per well to a v-bottom 96-well plate
Centrifuge the plate at 750 rpm for 3 minutes to sediment iPSCs into spheres

steps.title: Initial Incubation and Medium Exchange
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells and perform the first medium replacement.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells at 37 °C, 5% CO2, and 95% humidified chamber for 24 hours
Carefully remove all medium from the well
Replace with 100 µL per well of Neural Induction Medium, ensuring spheres are not disturbed or broken

steps.title: Neurosphere Maintenance
steps.instruction: Maintain neurospheres in the 96-well plate for 96 hours.

substeps.instruction: Perform daily half-volume medium changes by removing 50 µL and replacing with 50 µL
